counterexamples.conclusion: Reference tracking cannot replace fixed local acceptance.
Endpoint containment does not imply all-path containment.
Even all 20Hz samples inside cannot certify continuous containment.
Final error cannot erase earlier node deviations or prove route completion.
Lateral alone hides failed forward progress.
Actor/analyst cannot move the evaluation anchor to the observed state.
Local success retains inherited world error; latch time/node authority is fixed.
Raw heading change includes intentional rotation; not a heading-error metric.
Good geometry or reward cannot compensate a physical event.
Physical survival, skill status and complete mission remain separate.
Fixed ordered node membership cannot be replaced by reaching the final point.
Local-compliant endpoint needs nonzero reference deviation here; dynamics not established.
